name: Evilibrium: Soul Hunters
description:
About This Game

Evilibrium: Soul Hunters is a dark fantasy collectible card game and dungeon crawler set in a gothic world fueled by souls. Capture the souls of monsters, build an army, and command it in tactical real-time battles. Venture into dangerous dungeons where preparation determines what you can overcome and whether you return at all.

Enter an alternate early 20th century where Victor Frankenstein’s discovery that souls can power machines has transformed the world. Industrial powers, religious orders, and secret cults fight for control of this precious resource, while breaches in the very fabric of reality unleash otherworldly horrors. You are a Hunter with a forgotten past, drawn into a conflict that holds the secrets of your own identity. Uncover the truth of who you are and what happened to you as you explore a gothic soulpunk world brought to life through entirely handcrafted artwork.

Hunt monsters, capture their souls in cards, and summon your former enemies to fight alongside you. Choose your lineup and formation before each battle, then direct your creatures’ attacks and unleash their abilities as combat unfolds in real time. Preparation, target selection, and well-timed skills can turn a desperate encounter in your favor. With every soul you capture, your collection grows, bringing new powers and tactical possibilities to your command.

Level up and evolve your creatures, develop your Hunter’s combat and exploration skills, and upgrade your equipment. Combine complementary abilities and elemental affinities to strengthen your army and make your creatures more effective together. Your Hunter’s bonuses add another layer of strategy, allowing you to exploit enemy weaknesses. Experiment with different lineups and adapt your army to the challenges ahead.

Explore unique quest dungeons and return to procedurally generated depths in search of treasure and resources. Reveal what lies ahead tile by tile, and manage the items that could decide your next battle. Spending a precious supply now may keep your creatures alive, but leave you struggling later in the expedition. Death means losing everything, including experience. The true reward is making it back with what you fought to earn.
short_desc: Evilibrium: Soul Hunters is a dark fantasy collectible card game and dungeon crawler where you capture the souls of monsters to build an army. Collect and evolve creature cards, unleash their abilities in real-time battles, and explore a gothic world of dark science and secret cults.
